$comment: The DEPLOYABLE build: one bundle at dist/main.js. The default nest-cli.json emits plain tsc output whose require('@weyos/shared-schema') and require('@weyos/phenotype') resolve, at runtime, to the workspace packages' TypeScript SOURCE (their package.json main is src/index.ts). Node 24 happens to type-strip that locally; a container will not. webpack resolves the tsconfig paths at build time and bundles the workspace source in, and externalises node_modules as usual. Migrations are copied next to the bundle because MigrationRunner reads __dirname/migrations. Use: nest build -c nest-cli.bundle.json
